newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong Motor opens at yearly low.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong Motor opens at yearly low.

text.p: Shares in Ssangyong Motor, vehicle producer of South Korea's Ssangyong Group, went limit down to a yearly low at the opening on Wednesday on investor jitters about financial troubles in the conglomerate.
Ssangyong Group strongly denied rumours of cash flow problems in the group, South Korea's sixth largest.
Ssangyong Motor lost 340 won to 3,990 with the second largest trading volume of 286,570 at 0040 GMT.
Despite the group's denial, investors were still worrying about the future of Ssangyong group, brokers said.
They said the financial structure of the carmaker was in especially bad shape and that sluggish domestic car sales had led to cash flow problems in that affiliate.
